raw_text: OSINT analysis of the Shopian protest coordination reveals sophisticated tactics. Timed message bursts at exact 30-minute intervals across Telegram and X suggest pre-scheduled posting. Coded language ('chai at uncle's house' = rally point) used extensively. VPN usage spiked 400% in Shopian district after internet shutdown. This bypasses traditional shutdown-based crowd control.
